before battle!
fight_common/tool_fight.22872:
{speaker}: I have the reputation of all
BODYBUILDERS to uphold.
I'm not allowed to lose!
fight_common/tool_fight.22874:
{speaker}: There!
You won't forget what the "greatest's"
techniques will do to you!
fight_common/tool_fight.22875:
{speaker}: You're wanting to battle?
All right. I'm game.
fight_common/tool_fight.22877:
{speaker}: More! Much more!
I must gain more power!
fight_common/tool_fight.22878:
{speaker}: Let me show you how to battle
in the proper, authentic manner.
fight_common/tool_fight.22879:
{speaker}: What do you say?
Can you believe how strong I am?
fight_common/tool_fight.22881:
{speaker}: Come back when you toughen
up some more!
fight_common/tool_fight.22882:
{speaker}: Making my sweet POKéMON
battle isn't something I like doing...
But since we are, we'll battle to win!
fight_common/tool_fight.22883:
{speaker}: Your battling technique is
a little lacking.
fight_common/tool_fight.22886:
{speaker}: I trained with my POKéMON.
See how strong they are!
fight_common/tool_fight.22888:
{speaker}: Well?
What do you think of my act?
fight_common/tool_fight.22889:
{speaker}: That's good work!
You're quite the master!
fight_common/tool_fight.22892:
{speaker}: See? See?
Our power!
Isn't it fantastic?
fight_common/tool_fight.22893:
{speaker}: Your POKéMON are cute and
oh-so-strong.
fight_common/tool_fight.22894:
{speaker}: I'm going to really kick it into
gear!
fight_common/tool_fight.22896:
{speaker}: Let me evaluate your battling
skills.
fight_common/tool_fight.22898:
{speaker}: Didn't I say?
My POKéMON are world-beaters!
fight_common/tool_fight.22899:
{speaker}: There are no holidays for
battlers.
We battle anytime!
fight_common/tool_fight.22900:
{speaker}: I win!
Good working with you!
fight_common/tool_fight.22901:
{speaker}: You'll have to show me a more
interesting battle than that!
fight_common/tool_fight.22902:
{speaker}: Sure, let's battle.
I can feel the excitement coursing
through my veins!
fight_common/tool_fight.22904:
{speaker}: I'm mighty strong!
But don't you run!
fight_common/tool_fight.22905:
{speaker}: Perhaps it was fated that we
battle, you and I.
fight_common/tool_fight.22906: {speaker}: Winning pumps me up with pride!
fight_common/tool_fight.22908:
{speaker}: You're not an adequate partner
for me!
fight_common/tool_fight.22909:
{speaker}: Do you really want to take on
my POKéMON?
fight_common/tool_fight.22912: {speaker}: Heh, I reckon this is my win.
fight_common/tool_fight.22914:
{speaker}: Do you get it now?
Just how strong I am?
fight_common/tool_fight.22915:
{speaker}: You get my stamp of
authenticity!
fight_common/tool_fight.22916:
{speaker}: Let's compare muscles.
I wouldn't lose then!
fight_common/tool_fight.22919:
{speaker}: Leave everything to me!
I'll show you a battle that's both
magnificent and spectacular!
fight_common/tool_fight.22920:
{speaker}: I just gave you an example of
how to lose!
fight_common/tool_fight.22921:
{speaker}: Was my beautiful physique too
distracting for you to battle?
Wahahah!
fight_common/tool_fight.22923:
{speaker}: You're quite the intellectual
type, too.
fight_common/tool_fight.22925:
{speaker}: Well, you've taught me that
you really are strong.
fight_common/tool_fight.22926:
{speaker}: No way!
I won't believe this happened!
fight_common/tool_fight.22927:
{speaker}: Have you the ability to prevail
over me?
fight_common/tool_fight.22928:
{speaker}: A victory is never guaranteed.
You have to grab it and make it
your own!
fight_common/tool_fight.22929:
{speaker}: Your battling makes you good
enough to graduate.
fight_common/tool_fight.22930:
{speaker}: Get ready, because you're
going home a loser!
fight_common/tool_fight.22936:
{speaker}: I'm the kind of guy who always
strives for total victory in battle.
Victory shall be mine!
fight_common/tool_fight.22937:
{speaker}: Phew...
Your POKéMON skills are wicked!
fight_common/tool_fight.22939:
{speaker}: I won't stand for losing!
I battle to win!
fight_common/tool_fight.22940:
{speaker}: Go home, train some more,
then think about coming back!
fight_common/tool_fight.22941:
{speaker}: Winning isn't the only fun
part of battling!
But I'm really upset!
fight_common/tool_fight.22943:
{speaker}: If this were school, you'd make
the honor roll!
fight_common/tool_fight.22945:
{speaker}: Hi, are you the challenger?
What kind of style do you employ?
fight_common/tool_fight.22946:
{speaker}: A trainer of your class doesn't
stand a chance.
fight_common/tool_fight.22949:
{speaker}: Hey, not bad.
They're pretty strong.
fight_common/tool_fight.22950: {speaker}: Try keeping up with my pace!
fight_common/tool_fight.22951:
{speaker}: Wahahahahah!
Research upon research bears me out!
fight_common/tool_fight.22952:
{speaker}: Yippee!
I don't know how, but we won!
Battling is so enigmatic!
fight_common/tool_fight.22953:
{speaker}: Even though I lost, our battle
will be a fabulous memory.
Thank you.
fight_common/tool_fight.22955:
{speaker}: All right, then.
You're wanting to battle?
fight_common/tool_fight.22956:
{speaker}: Can you see how good I am
as a trainer?
fight_common/tool_fight.22958: {speaker}: A battle with me is never easy!
fight_common/tool_fight.22960:
{speaker}: I'll collect battle data from
you, too!
fight_common/tool_fight.22961:
{speaker}: Did you want to take on my
POKéMON?
fight_common/tool_fight.22962:
{speaker}: Full throttle!
That's what I am!
fight_common/tool_fight.22963:
{speaker}: I'd really like to show you
an authentic battle.
fight_common/tool_fight.22964:
{speaker}: Get some more training in.
You might have a chance at winning.
fight_common/tool_fight.22965:
{speaker}: Yup, yup!
We'll take the win!
fight_common/tool_fight.22968:
{speaker}: I'm a veteran, I tell you.
Surely you don't think you'll win?
fight_common/tool_fight.22969:
{speaker}: This is an example of how
to win!
fight_common/tool_fight.22970:
{speaker}: Sigh...
I guess I lost.
Those things are bound to happen
sometimes.
fight_common/tool_fight.22971:
{speaker}: Can I check out how tough your
POKéMON are?
fight_common/tool_fight.22972:
{speaker}: Well, do you get it now?
Do you understand how truly strong
I am?
fight_common/tool_fight.22975:
{speaker}: Hey, you, you want to see me
battle?
It will cost you!
fight_common/tool_fight.22977:
{speaker}: I commend you for coming!
Let your eyes burn with the glory of
the DOUBLE BATTLE to end all
DOUBLE BATTLES!
fight_common/tool_fight.22978:
{speaker}: Oh... So I lost.
I said I would win, but I didn't say
I would win for sure!
fight_common/tool_fight.22979:
{speaker}: I'd like to see just how strong
you are.
fight_common/tool_fight.22981:
{speaker}: You have to battle me, huh?
I feel sorry for you.
Anyways, here goes.
fight_common/tool_fight.22982: {speaker}: I've lost more than I care to!
fight_common/tool_fight.22983:
{speaker}: Weren't they great?
Well?
Did we stun you?
fight_common/tool_fight.22984:
{speaker}: Urrrgh...
Even after all that training...
fight_common/tool_fight.22985:
{speaker}: I think you can keep winning
all the way through like you've
done so far.
Let me cheer you on!
fight_common/tool_fight.22986:
{speaker}: What a unique battle style!
I give up. My hat's off to you!
Hahaha!
fight_common/tool_fight.22987:
{speaker}: Fuuugaaah! Fuuugaaah!
I'm not gonna lose!
fight_common/tool_fight.22988:
{speaker}: Oh, you're strong, all right.
We were plowed under.
fight_common/tool_fight.22989:
{speaker}: Yo, yo, yo!
Let me battle with yo' POKéMON!
fight_common/tool_fight.22990:
{speaker}: This is my power!
This is my ability!
fight_common/tool_fight.22993:
{speaker}: Let's battle and work up
a good sweat!
fight_common/tool_fight.22994:
{speaker}: Okay, what are you going to
throw at me?
fight_common/tool_fight.22995:
{speaker}: My POKéMON research is
unimpeachable!
I'll even prove it!
fight_common/tool_fight.22996:
{speaker}: You're going up against my
wonderful POKéMON!
fight_common/tool_fight.22997:
{speaker}: This match belonged to me from
the get-go!
fight_common/tool_fight.22998:
{speaker}: I'll finish this battle in
a world-record time!
fight_common/tool_fight.23001:
{speaker}: I'm gonna work!
And my POKéMON are gonna battle!
fight_common/tool_fight.23002:
{speaker}: It has been much too long
since I last enjoyed a battle this
thoroughly.
fight_common/tool_fight.23003:
{speaker}: The next time we battle, I'm
going to win!
fight_common/tool_fight.23004:
{speaker}: Look at my POKéMON!
They're buff and sculpted to the max!
fight_common/tool_fight.23005: {speaker}: My art is unique under the sun!
fight_common/tool_fight.23006:
{speaker}: I'm afraid you're no good.
Still, it just means that I am superior
to you.
fight_common/tool_fight.23008:
{speaker}: Gggguh!
I've much to learn still.
This is no time to be mourning a loss!
fight_common/tool_fight.23009:
{speaker}: I want to battle a lot more
than this!
fight_common/tool_fight.23010:
{speaker}: Words can't express how
wonderful battles are.
It's so exquisite!
fight_common/tool_fight.23012:
{speaker}: Just plowing ahead in
a straight line won't let me win!
fight_common/tool_fight.23013:
{speaker}: Listen, sonny.
I might be an old woman, but I don't
expect you to go easy on me.
fight_common/tool_fight.23015:
{speaker}: I was the stronger of the two
of us!
fight_common/tool_fight.23016:
{speaker}: See that?
That's what I call a real POKéMON
battle.
fight_common/tool_fight.23018:
{speaker}: My POKéMON, they're itching
to battle.
Let's go!
fight_common/tool_fight.23020:
{speaker}: My POKéMON are raring to
battle!
fight_common/tool_fight.23021:
{speaker}: Are your POKéMON all that
strong?
fight_common/tool_fight.23023: {speaker}: This is the way that I battle!
fight_common/tool_fight.23024: {speaker}: This is how it should be!
fight_common/tool_fight.23025: {speaker}: How about you try beating me?
fight_common/tool_fight.23026:
{speaker}: Your brawn can't overcome
my brain.
fight_common/tool_fight.23027:
{speaker}: When it comes to battling, even
grown-ups can't beat me.
fight_common/tool_fight.23028:
{speaker}: I hate anyone who can't abide
by the rules.
When I battle, everything's on the
straight and narrow!
fight_common/tool_fight.23029:
{speaker}: I've grown quite old, but
quit battling?
Never!
fight_common/tool_fight.23030: {speaker}: Don't say I didn't warn you.
fight_common/tool_fight.23034:
{speaker}: Launch aborted!
Why did we fail?
fight_common/tool_fight.23035:
{speaker}: I like that look you have in
your eyes.
fight_common/tool_fight.23038:
{speaker}: I'm in a foul mood!
You're gonna pay for it!
fight_common/tool_fight.23039:
{speaker}: You couldn't keep up with my
battling, could you?
fight_common/tool_fight.23040:
{speaker}: My POKéMON don't measure
up to yours.
fight_common/tool_fight.23041:
{speaker}: I get the feeling that you'll
become stronger still.
fight_common/tool_fight.23043:
{speaker}: You're no threat to this old
woman.
fight_common/tool_fight.23044:
{speaker}: Are you ready, because here we
come.
Be careful not to get hurt!
fight_common/tool_fight.23047:
{speaker}: What was that about?
You're not strong one bit!
fight_common/tool_fight.23048:
{speaker}: Victory is elusive!
But I will prevail!
fight_common/tool_fight.23049:
{speaker}: Whoops!
We lost, somehow.
Too bad.
fight_common/tool_fight.23051:
{speaker}: Sorry to disappoint you!
I'm actually strong!
fight_common/tool_fight.23052:
{speaker}: You fell short, but not by
much.
fight_common/tool_fight.23056:
{speaker}: Crank me up!
I'm going full throttle into battle!
fight_common/tool_fight.23057:
{speaker}: To be beaten by children...
That'll be a long time coming!
fight_common/tool_fight.23058:
{speaker}: Are you battling?
Let's you and me have a battle.
fight_common/tool_fight.23061:
{speaker}: I lost the battle, but I managed
to collect interesting data.
fight_common/tool_fight.23062:
{speaker}: It's all very simple, really.
I was stronger than you, as simple as
that.
fight_common/tool_fight.23063:
{speaker}: This is the true power of
cool!
fight_common/tool_fight.23064: {speaker}: It's not like I always win!
fight_common/tool_fight.23065:
{speaker}: Here we come!
You'd better be ready!
fight_common/tool_fight.23066:
{speaker}: I told you, did I not?
I'm a veteran.
fight_common/tool_fight.23067:
{speaker}: Please don't even think about
beating my POKéMON.
fight_common/tool_fight.23068:
{speaker}: I got a good feel for your
power.
I'd call that a great battle.
fight_common/tool_fight.23069:
{speaker}: What's wrong here?
I lost, but there's something missing.
fight_common/tool_fight.23070:
{speaker}: The way my POKéMON and I
cavort and wheel, why, we must look
like dancing fairies!
fight_common/tool_fight.23071:
{speaker}: I'm gaining confidence in my
training!
